title: 第19章 嫂子 老三体力这么好第20章 捕冰鱼
slug: 我能给箭术加点从猎户到斩仙
content_zh:
李玄心念一动，依循提示，将全部意念聚焦于【兽宠】那一栏。
视野如水波般轻轻荡漾，面板的景象随之变幻。
一个微缩的、半透明的小狼虚影悄然浮现，轮廓分明.
正是他揣在怀里带回来的那个小东西。
明暗各异的光点，如星辰般嵌在虚影的关键位置，头颅、四肢、脊柱、腰腹……以及，胸腔正中。
那些光点，想必就是可强化的“部位”
意念如无形指尖，轻轻触碰那些光点。
触及狼吻处的光点，信息浮现：
【强化利齿（010）：小幅提升咬合力与骨质硬度，增强撕裂效果。
【强化肌腱（012）：提升奔跑爆发力与瞬间转向灵活性。
【强化骨骼（015）：提升负重能力与抗击打强度。
【强化腰力（018）：提升扑击力量与长途奔袭耐力。
……
每个部位都标注着不同的强化需求点数。
显然是一个需要长远规划、针对性投入的体系。
李玄心中颇感新奇，这恐怕比提升自身属性更耗费点数。
然而，当他的意念扫过小狼虚影胸腔正中。
那个本应代表心脏位置的光点时，心神骤然一紧。
与其他部位稳定散发柔白或淡蓝微光不同。
那处光点正以一种紊乱的节奏明灭闪烁，透出黯淡而不祥的暗红色。

如同风中之烛，随时可能彻底熄灭。
集中意识探查，一行刺目的信息清晰浮现：
【心脏：先天性发育不全（重度），心脉孱弱，供血效率严重不足，伴随隐性衰竭。
当前状态：濒临功能崩溃。
自然存活概率：极低。
预估存活时限：5-12日。
【治疗方案：消耗10点狩猎点数进行“生命源泉”
强化，重塑心脏结构，稳固生命本源。
“原来如此……”
李玄恍然，之前总觉得这小狼崽虚弱得有些异常，不仅仅是饥饿寒冷所致。
竟是身患致命的先天心疾！
在残酷的狼群法则中，这样的幼崽被果断抛弃，几乎是必然的命运。
若非自己拥有这奇异的面板，它绝无生机。
content_en:
Li Xuan thought about it, followed the prompts, and focused all his thoughts on the [Beast Pet] column.
The field of vision ripples gently like water waves, and the scene on the panel changes accordingly.
A miniature, translucent wolf phantom quietly emerged, with clear outlines.
It was the little thing he brought back in his arms.
Spots of light of varying brightness and darkness were embedded in the shadow's key locations like stars, including the head, limbs, spine, waist and abdomen... and the center of the chest.
Those light spots must be "parts" that can be strengthened
Thoughts are like invisible fingertips, gently touching those light spots.
Touching the light spot at the wolf's snout, information emerged:
[Strengthened Sharp Teeth (010): Slightly increase the bite force and bone hardness, and enhance the tearing effect.
[Strengthen tendons (012): Improve running explosive power and instant turning flexibility.
[Strengthen bones (015): Improve weight-bearing capacity and resistance to blows.
[Strengthen waist strength (018): Improve attack power and long-distance running endurance.
…
Each part is marked with different strengthening requirements points.
It is obviously a system that requires long-term planning and targeted investment.
Li Xuan was quite curious. This might cost more points than improving his own attributes.
However, when his thoughts swept through the middle of the little wolf's phantom chest.
When he saw the light spot that was supposed to represent the position of his heart, his mind suddenly tightened.
Unlike other areas that steadily emit a soft white or light blue shimmer.
The light spot was flickering on and off in a chaotic rhythm, revealing a dim and ominous dark red color.
Like a candle in the wind, it may be completely extinguished at any time.
Focusing on the consciousness exploration, a line of dazzling information clearly emerged:
[Heart: Congenital hypoplasia (severe), weak heart arteries, severely insufficient blood supply efficiency, accompanied by hidden failure.
Current status: On the verge of functional collapse.
Natural survival probability: extremely low.
Estimated survival time: 5-12 days.
[Treatment plan: Spend 10 hunting points to perform "Source of Life"
Strengthen and reshape the heart structure and stabilize the origin of life.
"That's it..."
Li Xuan suddenly realized that he had always felt that the little wolf cub was abnormally weak, not just due to hunger and cold.
He actually suffered from a fatal congenital heart disease!
In the cruel laws of the wolf pack, it is almost an inevitable fate for such cubs to be decisively abandoned.
If he didn't own this strange panel, it would never be alive.
